newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Mercosur nations to meet with Australia, NZ.
newsitem.headline: Mercosur nations to meet with Australia, NZ.

text.p: Trade officials from the South American customs union Mercosur were due to meet Wednesday with counterparts from Australia and New Zealand to improve ties between the two regions, an official said Tuesday.
The meeting in Rio de Janeiro represented the first formal talks between the four-nation Mercosur and the two members of the Australia-New Zealand Closer Economic Trade Agreement, known as CER.
Mercosur comprises Argentina, Brazil, Paraguay and Uruguay.

Officials from the two blocs have already met on an informal basis to determine areas where cooperation could be improved, in particular rules for bilateral investment and transport, said the official with Brazil's Foreign Ministry.
The Mercosur-CER talks precede a meeting of the 15-nation Cairns Group of grain exporting nations which takes place Thursday and Friday in Rio.
